dimensions.assessment: Affects federal review board members, state and local governments submitting records, and the public seeking access to civil rights cold case files.
dimensions.evidence: Upon request of a State or local government to the Review Board, the Review Board may reimburse the State or local government in full

dimensions.assessment: Provides operational adjustments like expense reimbursements and record disclosure rule changes, rather than broad life-changing mandates for the general public.
Authorizes reimbursements to state or local governments for digitizing, photocopying, or mailing records to the Archivist, but specifies no exact dollar amount.
dimensions.evidence: reimburse the State or local government in full for any expense incurred... for digitizing, photocopying, or mailing

dimensions.assessment: Amends the Civil Rights Cold Case Records Collection Act of 2018 by expanding board tenure from 7 to 11 years, altering disclosure exemptions, and updating state record transmission rules.
dimensions.evidence: Section 5(n)(1) of Civil Rights Cold Case Records Collection Act of 2018... by striking '7 years' and inserting '11 years'

dimensions.assessment: Extends the tenure of the Review Board by four years (from 7 to 11 total years) and alters permanent record disclosure provisions.

missing_information: Total expected cost of state and local expense reimbursements
Number of additional records expected to be processed
importance_detail.rationale: The bill extends the tenure of the Civil Rights Cold Case Records Review Board, permits full expense reimbursements to state and local governments, and adjusts disclosure exemptions for certain historical records.
